entries.zh: 告知、示意（avisar 的对音；描=表示、比划告知）
entries.en: to give notice, to indicate; to make known
entries.notes: 「描」字与 avisar 对音稍隔，语义靠西语词头推断，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 告知各家社甲（遍告全乡里社）
entries.en: to notify every house and village community (avisar a todo el pueblo)
to report to a superior, to petition (ssup. = superior)
to report on some matter of business
to notify in writing; a written statement / petition
entries.notes: 西语 escripto=书面，与「词」（状词）相合；单字释义稍泛。

entries.en: to submit in writing, to present a petition

entries.zh: 落人口（有时传告于人；落人于口，播人口实）
entries.en: to spread word among people from time to time; to put into people's mouths
entries.notes: 四栏互证大致成立，唯「落人口」确切习语义偏推断，降 medium。

entries.zh: 谨禀（恭敬禀告上司并请示）
entries.en: to respectfully report to a superior and request leave/permission
to report, to petition (obsolete Spanish gloss lines struck out in the original)
entries.notes: 西语栏多条被删且语序残乱，仅存告禀核心义，降 medium。

entries.zh: 透露根机（向敌人泄露内情、机密；告密）
entries.en: to reveal to the enemy the hidden secret / inner intentions; to betray (el seno el traidor)
to send word, to pass on a message (dar recado)
to tell by word of mouth, to spread by speech

entries.zh: 传下手（传教义于门徒手下；传授）
entries.en: to hand down, to teach (those with whom one deals) with Doctrine (catechism)
entries.notes: 西语栏缩略语序含混（los con quien. con Dõtrina），义为以教理传授，故 medium。

entries.zh: 传圣旨（颁传圣旨并公布之）
entries.en: to transmit (imperial) edicts and publish them

entries.zh: 动方（报知年岁风向；动问四方风信）
entries.en: to give notice of the winds of the year; weather/season news
entries.notes: 「动方」与 vientos del ano 对应属推断性对译，降 medium。

entries.en: to shake, to waver
entries.notes: 西语栏 delsto inventa 疑为原件误录/残损，据汉字动摇与音写定义，降 medium。

entries.en: not yet

entries.zh: 未闲（还未有空、尚无闲暇）
entries.en: there is no place/leisure yet; not yet the time (aun no ay lugar)
entries.notes: 「闲」音写 ēng 与西语 lugar（空/暇）相合，但字面与语义转换稍推断，降 medium。

entries.en: now; present, to appear (marked + aun in the original)
entries.notes: 西语栏仅 + aun 记号，释义主要依汉字「现」，降 medium。

entries.en: there is now, at present there is/are
still, yet; (also) to return
entries.notes: 西语栏仅 + aun，单字「还」多义（仍旧/归还），取副义为主并附次义，降 medium。

entries.en: still not, not yet
